messages:
Jamie: quick heads-up — PR #9124 looks ready but canary shows p95 tail bump on 4k sequences. Need one final approval + merge timing. bench logs below. :eyes:

Sasha: can you paste the bench numbers and the canary link?

Jamie: sure — canary run https://canary.redwood.internal/deploys/9124 ; bench snippet:
```
model: redwood-4k-v2
seq: 4k
baseline p95: 42ms
current p95: 47ms  (+11.9%)
throughput: 980 req/s -> 970 req/s (≈ -1%)
mem: RSS 14.2GB -> 14.8GB (+4.2%)
traces: tail spikes at ~2.9s on a small subset (20/5000)
heatmap: tail concentrated during kv-prefill async path
```
root cause hypothesis: prefill path interacts with microbatcher on longseq.

Diego: is this regression vs last stable canary or vs main? any perf CI data?

Jamie: vs last-stable. Perf CI shows similar small uptick on two runs, not just noise. attaching quick flame: `flame_9124.png` (in thread).

Olivia: prefer to land in maintenance window 02:30–03:30 UTC if we're going to merge. Can we do a quick mitigation patch instead?

Sasha: i can add a small guard to disable prefill on requests >2k seqs, quick patch — adds an if early return. Should cut the tail but keep most perf.

Ravi: can you add the repro command? i'll run locally against canary image.

Jamie: repro:
```
./bench_longseq --model redwood-4k-v2 --seq 4096 --clients 16 --duration 180
```
use `CANARY_IMAGE=ghcr.io/redwood/serving:9124` to reproduce.

ops-bot: Canary deployment 9124 started 2026-03-18T01:40Z — 6/10 shards healthy, monitoring tail-latency.

Sasha: ok i'm pushing the guard now. PR updated: #9125 — small change, no model changes. request: 1 approval for merge.

Diego: +1 (ran local smoke, tail reduced to baseline in my run).

Olivia: +1, schedule 02:30 UTC merge and smoke.

Jamie: thanks all — i'll merge at 02:30 and run smoke-run; will rollback if p95 > 45ms or tail > baseline +5%.

Ravi: running repro now, will post results in 20m.

Ravi: (20m later) local run: p95 44ms, mem 14.3GB; tail events gone. LGTM. :thumbsup:

Jamie: merging in maintenance window. :party-parrot:
